headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: PER (5)

summary: Lewis Hamilton won the British Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 1.5s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Lando Norris completing the podium.
Kevin Magnussen made the biggest climb, from P17 to P12.
Guanyu Zhou had a day to forget, dropping from P14 to P18.
There were 45 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 84 points over Lando Norris.
